name: Gardes Heiden
source:
Target of Kia's secret mission.

He's a wealthy man who apparently abuses his wife. [spoiler]However, this was all a lie Richard made up in order to get revenge. It turns out he had fallen in love with his stepmother before they had even gotten married, and he thinks his dad "stole" her from him.[/spoiler]
